# Some inspiration

- **Turing.** Small packages that other people build on, rather than one
  library
- **SciML.** Shared interfaces, and downstream CI run against packages it
  does not own
- **rOpenSci.** Software peer review and a written package guide. Julia has
  nothing like it

::: {.attribution}
[SciML governance](https://sciml.ai/governance/), whose downstream CI runs
`ProbNumDiffEq.jl` and `PositiveIntegrators.jl`, and
[rOpenSci software review](https://ropensci.org/software-review/), both read

:::
